predictions: fire 0.4-0.7 on 機 before 率 or 会; near misses that say probability or chance with 概率, 可能, 率 alone below 0.2. The pole is broad, so near misses may fire weakly
short: 機 in 機率 / 機会 ('chance')
notes: Card: broad (2.4% of tokens); peaks on '_value' x10, Spanish preterite 'ó' x6, '機' x2 (成功機率, 悔い改める機会). Probe: 成功機率 0.647, se reunió 0.518; return_value only 0.163, English probability 0.058. 機 in a chance compound is the strongest repeatable trigger; the Spanish preterite is a second, untested side.
